description: This file provides a generic implementation of the Poly1305 MAC algorithm, including functions for summing messages, initializing state, updating with message chunks, and finalizing the MAC. It contains internal cryptographic computations and data structures specific to Poly1305.

classes.name: macState
classes.description: Holds the internal state of the MAC, including accumulator and key components.

classes.name: macGeneric
classes.description: Represents the MAC context, including state, buffer, and offset.

classes.name: uint128
classes.description: Represents a 128-bit number as two 64-bit limbs for internal calculations.

methods.name: sumGeneric
methods.description: Computes the Poly1305 sum (MAC) for a message with a given key and outputs the result.

methods.name: newMACGeneric
methods.description: Initializes a new MAC context with a given key.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Splits input message into chunks, updates internal state, buffers incomplete chunks.

methods.name: Sum
methods.description: Finalizes the MAC computation, producing the authentication tag.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads a 256-bit key into internal state components, applying clamping masks.

methods.name: updateGeneric
methods.description: Absorbs message chunks into the MAC state, performing modular multiplication and reduction.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes the modular reduction and computes the final MAC tag.
